title: Construction of NA-II Twin Quarter at Pentakota Lighthouse station along with beautification of the station
summary: Percentage-rate e-tender for constructing a NA-II twin staff quarter and beautifying Pentakota Lighthouse station, Anakapalli district, Andhra Pradesh, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam

sites.name: Pentakota Lighthouse, Satyavaram (post), Anakapalli-531127
sites.work: Construction of NA-II twin quarter and beautification of the station

scope.item: Construction of NA-II Twin Quarter along with beautification of the station

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST and all other taxes. Tender fee Nil. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, payable at Visakhapatnam, valid three months from technical bid opening. EMD expressly not exempted for any bidder (including NSIC/MSME) owing to past delays; EMD forfeited if timelines not followed.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of tender

eligibility: Valid civil registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies, and valid electrical licence
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%; supported by completion certificates; values enhanced at 7% simple per annum
Similar works: construction of residential/non-residential buildings, civil and electrical or composite (civil, electrical) works of any number of storeys
Average annual turnover of last three financial years at least 30% of estimated cost
PAN and GST registration; key technical personnel; unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure V); tender acceptance letter (Annexure IV); affidavit of not being blacklisted
Income tax returns for last three years; list of relatives serving in MoPSW/DGLL; activity chart/plan; self-assessing technical evaluation sheet
